title: Efate Scenic Round Island Tour
description: Experience the Best of Efate: Join our comprehensive 7-hour "Round Island" adventure (8 am – 3 pm).
Top Attractions: Visit the local chocolate factory, take a refreshing dip at Raru Waterfall, and experience the famous Blue Lagoon rope swings.
All-Inclusive: Relax with lunch at Banana Bay Beach Club, duty-free shopping stops, and all entry fees included.
Pricing: AUD$120 per adult | AUD$60 per child (<12 yrs). Min 10-14 pax.

title: Ekasup Cultural Village Tour
description: Step back in time and experience the authentic, ancient Melanesian way of life. The Ekasup Cultural Village is an immersive journey into the heart and soul of traditional Vanuatu culture.
• Welcome by the Chief with a traditional warrior dance.
• Demonstrations of traditional hunting, trapping, and fishing methods.
• Learn the secrets of food preservation and natural medicines.
• Experience custom magic and hear ancient legends passed down natively.
